_note: Stage 1 (地基) for real_place/build_ground.py: the land's shape, the water and the road network; nothing else is drawn. Heights: FABDEM bare-earth estimate (about 30 m samples), then the design rules of real_place/terrain_rules.py (numbers in rules): pitches, plazas, building pads, platforms and lakes flat, roads within their grade, banks, steps and walls between them, the whole equal to FABDEM over mass_box_m. Cover: water, road_slot on the road network, ground_slot everywhere else. Slots are colour slots (core/slots.tres) and set walking cost (core/walk_costs.json).

roads._note: The network that cuts the site into blocks: every OSM way of a network kind, plus walkways of a connector kind that join it at both ends (within end_snap_m) and are at least min_length_m long. Everything else (garden paths, plazas, dead-end walkways) is stage 2. Widths by OSM kind unless the way has a width tag; roads at least flat_end_min_width_m wide end square.

rules._note: real_place/terrain_rules.py. Sources: road_grade_max GB 50352-2019 5.3.2-1 (基地内机动车道纵坡不应大于8%); special_segment_m same clause (特殊路段坡长不应大于100m) with 5.3.2-5 (山地可适当放宽): a stretch the DEM climbs faster over this length keeps the DEM's grade; walk_grade_max GB 50352-2019 5.3.2-3 (步行道不应大于8%，大于时设置为台阶步道); stair_slope GB 50352-2019 6.7.1 (踏步宽不小于0.3m、高不大于0.15m); step_height_m the same step, smaller drops are not drops; bank_gentle GB 51192-2016 5.1.5 (绿地适宜坡度5%~20%); bank_max CJJ 83-2016 8.0.5 (土质护坡坡比值不应大于0.67); bank_max_drop_m CJJ 83-2016 8.0.5 (高差大于或等于3.0m宜挡土墙结合放坡); floor_above_ground_m GB 50037-2013 3.1.5 (底层地面宜高出室外地面150mm). mass_box_m: equal to the DEM averaged over this; mass_passes: correction passes. Trial and checks: research/sdu_weihai/terrain_trials/round2/报告.md.

lakes._note: Water surface level (default: lower quartile of the DEM over the water); bank_m is the stone edge above it.

platforms_note: Levelled ground traced from the 2025 imagery on 5 m grids (real_place/view_area.py), levelled at the median ground over it. Shapes: polygon, rect, octagon, circle, with union / minus.

backdrop._note: Scenery beyond the campus to the site edge (group backdrop, not walkable): sea and land only. Sea from the Copernicus water mask, its coast refined by the imagery. Heights smoothed (gaussian smooth_m), fading in over smooth_blend_m from the campus edge so the seam matches; the land comes down to the sea over shore_m.
